certificate.description: The Edge SWG appliances from Symantec provide companies the ability to deploy a scalable proxy-based security solution to protect their organization against advanced threats. The Edge SWG acts as gateway between web users and the Internet: a single point where all web traffic can be monitored and corporate policies for web use can be enforced.
